codes.title: The Code on Wages, 2019
codes.scope: Minimum wages, payment of wages, payment of bonus, equal remuneration, deductions, wage period, definition of 'wages', 'employee', 'worker', appropriate Government for wage matters.

codes.title: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020
codes.scope: Trade unions, standing orders, industrial disputes, strikes and lock-outs, lay-off, retrenchment, closure, works committees, grievance redressal, negotiating unions.

codes.title: The Code on Social Security, 2020
codes.scope: Provident fund, ESI/insurance, gratuity, maternity benefit, employees' compensation, pension, building & construction workers' cess, unorganised/gig/platform workers, definition of 'wages' for contribution purposes.
replaced_acts: The Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
The Employment Exchanges (Compulsory Notification of Vacancies) Act, 1959
The Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Cess Act, 1996
The Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act, 2008

codes.title: The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
codes.scope: Workplace safety and health, working hours, leave, welfare facilities, hazardous processes, contract labour, inter-state migrant workers, factories, mines, dock work, plantations, registration and licensing of establishments.

central_rules.title: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (Central) Rules, 2020

replaced_acts: The Dock Workers (Safety, Health and Welfare) Act, 1986
The Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970
The Working Journalists and other Newspaper Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1955
The Sales Promotion Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1976
The Beedi and Cigar Workers (Conditions of Employment) Act, 1966
The Cine-Workers and Cinema Theatre Workers (Regulation of Employment) Act, 1981
The Building and Other Construction Workers (RE&CS) Act, 1996
